doc: Spec 02 (boots) views of §1.3. V1 and V2 are hero crops of each boot (their own boxes, so not aliases of ref.boots_feet), rendered on copies of both boots placed at spec 08's hero transforms. V3-V9 are closeups in frame B of the left boot (`Frame.Boot.L`, identical to spec 01's frame F), expanded by `sides` to .L and .R with the right one mirrored in X, rendered on a copy of one boot standing in frame B on the floor; the copies are made after the part saves its cache and never cached (spec 02 §1.3 note, §0 item 8). 2026-10-27: every view hides Body.Mesh and the Foot.* and Sock.* objects (the bound boots stand under the rest feet, and the rest foot stands through the seated boot), and V3-V9 hide the other boot (the boots stand 200 mm apart in rest, so it enters V3's and V6's frames; V7 already hid it, spec 17 §4.14). V8 (lateral three-quarter) and V9 (rear) are added: whole-boot form views at a natural perspective, judged in clay beside the reference scan of spec 02 §3.6 when it is fetched.

presets.label: sole_below
presets.note: lug plan; no reference view exists (spec 02 §3.3 tables)

presets.label: lateral_34
presets.note: 2026-10-27 (spec 02 §0 items 8, 9): the whole boot from lateral-front-above at about 0.8 m, its large forms at a natural perspective (proportions, toe spring, toe-box dome, shaft taper and lean, the lateral Cordura panel, keeper and tail, counter, folds and wear); judged in clay beside the reference scan R1 (spec 02 §3.6) when fetched

presets.label: rear
presets.note: 2026-10-27 (spec 02 §0 items 8, 9): the heel and shaft from behind, level: the counter's bell over the heel (the foot's critics found a box from behind), the shaft's taper into the collar, Achilles notch, backstrap, pull loop, the buckle at phi 150 deg, heel-strike wear; no drawn view exists, so the reference is the scan R1 when fetched
